name: Pas Seul
description: Pas Seul is a Klondike-variant patience game for one player. Only one pass through the deck is allowed. Build from Aces to Kings in suit on four foundations; six tableau piles build down in alternating colors. Turn cards from stock to waste; only the top card of the waste is playable. The name refers to a dance sequence for one person.

history.origins: Country/Region of Origin: Europe. Pas Seul is a Klondike-style patience game; the name is French for "solo step" or a dance for one person. One pass through the deck distinguishes it from standard Klondike.
timeline: Origins: Klondike variant with single-pass rule
Modern: Played as solitaire in print and digital implementations

setup.players: One player. Pas Seul is a single-player patience (solitaire) game.
setup.deck: Type: Standard 52-card deck. One deck. No jokers.
setup.dealing: Layout: Place four foundation spaces (upper right). Six tableau piles (main stacks) below. Stock (closed deck) upper left; waste pile next to it. Deal one card face-up to each of the six tableau piles to start (or per variant). Remaining cards form the stock. Only one pass through the stock is allowed.
setup.equipment: Standard 52-card deck and table space for stock, waste, six tableau piles, and four foundations.

rules.objective: Build all four foundations from Ace to King in suit. The game is won when all 52 cards are on the foundations.
rules.gameplay: 1. Turn a card from the stock onto the waste; only the topmost card of the waste may be played. 2. The top waste card may be moved to a foundation (build up in suit from Ace to King) or to a tableau pile. 3. On the tableau, build down in alternating colors; any card may be placed on an empty tableau pile. 4. You may move one or more cards from one tableau pile to another when the build rule holds. 5. Only one pass through the stock is allowed; there is no redeal.
keyRules: Foundations: build ascending in the same suit from Ace to King.
Tableau: build descending in alternating colors; only the top card of a pile is movable.
Only the top card of the waste pile may be played to foundation or tableau.
One pass through the deck only; no redeal.

strategy.basic: Expose high cards and Aces early; build foundations as soon as possible; avoid blocking tableau piles with low cards.
strategy.intermediate: Prefer moving from waste to foundation when legal; move tableau cards to free spaces and unblock lower cards; plan the single pass through the stock.
strategy.advanced: Order of turning stock cards is critical; look ahead to which tableau columns will accept which ranks; minimize deadlock in the single pass.
tips: Only one pass through the deck; plan before turning from stock.
Empty tableau piles accept any card; use them to reorder sequences.
Build foundations steadily; delayed Aces can block the game.

scoring.winCondition: Win when all four foundations are built from Ace to King in suit (all 52 cards on foundations).

synthesis.shortDescription: Pas Seul is a one-deck Klondike-style solitaire. One pass through the deck; build foundations in suit and tableau in alternating colors.
